labels.heading: 3 cases of RabbitMQ message loss
labels.case2:
2. RabbitMQ receives the message and holds it
temporarily in memory; before it is consumed,
RabbitMQ itself crashes and the data in memory is lost
labels.case1: 1. The message is lost in transit
labels.case3:
3. The consumer receives the message but crashes
before it can process it, and RabbitMQ
thinks the message has already been processed
labels._title: Three cases of RabbitMQ message loss
labels._desc: A producer sends messages through RabbitMQ to a consumer, with the three points where a message can be lost.
